chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr and Fadalah from Jamil from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:
"The kiss does not break the fast."

key_terms.اَلصَّوْمَ: The fast (abstaining from food, drink, etc.)

ai.seo_question: Does kissing invalidate the fast in Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on fasting errors, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies that a simple kiss (*al-qubla*) does not break the fast, distinguishing it from acts that lead to ejaculation. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle of leniency in minor physical interactions during fasting, provided they do not result in the release of semen, thereby preserving the spiritual integrity of the fast without imposing undue hardship.
